hero.title: An Authentic Balinese Cocktail Class Experience
hero.bodyPrefix: Shake, stir, and sip your way through an interactive cocktail-making experience at
hero.bodySuffix: , inspired by the vibrant flavors of Bali. Available daily, and if you visit on a Thursday, stay on and pair it with our complimentary Balinese Dance Performance from 7 PM.

intro.body: This cocktail-making class is your chance to discover the creativity, craftsmanship, and tropical flavors behind Bali's vibrant bar culture. Learn the stories behind local ingredients in a fun, interactive session suited to beginners and cocktail enthusiasts alike.

featureRows.title: The Spirit of Bali
featureRows.desc: Every exceptional cocktail begins with quality ingredients and the perfect balance of technique. Throughout the experience, you'll explore tropical fruits, premium mixers, authentic Balinese Arak, and professional bartending methods.

featureRows.title: Create Memories Behind the Bar
featureRows.desc: This class is about more than mixing drinks. It's about creativity, connection, and the moments you'll remember, from your first shake to your final sip.

dailySessions.heading: Daily Sessions
dailySessions.subheading: Choose the time that suits your Bali itinerary

sessions.name: Session 1
sessions.desc: A relaxed late-morning session to kick off your day with a hands-on cocktail lesson.

sessions.name: Session 2
sessions.desc: Perfect between sightseeing and your evening plans.

sessions.name: Session 3
sessions.desc: Wind down as the evening begins, finishing with your own handcrafted cocktail.

dailySessions.notePrefix: Booking the 5 PM session on a Thursday? Stay on after 7 PM for our complimentary
dailySessions.noteSuffix: , the only one in Nusa Dua, free for dining guests.

items.title: Hands-on Bartender Class
items.desc: Learn professional bartending techniques in a fun and interactive one-hour session.

items.title: Balinese Refreshment
items.desc: Enjoy traditional Jajan Bali served with light refreshments during your class.

items.title: Arak Tasting
items.desc: Experience the distinctive character of authentic Balinese Arak and discover its role in local cocktail culture.

items.title: Certificate of Completion
items.desc: Receive a certificate to commemorate your mixology experience at Raja Bali Restaurant.

items.title: Signature Cocktail
items.desc: Create and enjoy your own handcrafted cocktail under the guidance of our expert bartender.

items.title: Balinese Dance (Thursdays)
items.desc: If your session falls on a Thursday, stay on and enjoy the complimentary Balinese dance performance from 7 PM, free for dining guests.

local.name: Local Cocktail
local.desc: Discover the rich character of authentic Balinese Arak through two signature local cocktails.

local.name: Mocktail
local.desc: A vibrant alcohol-free creation bursting with tropical fruit flavors.

international.name: International Cocktail
international.sub: Long Island Iced Tea or Tequila Sunrise
international.desc: Master one of the world's most beloved cocktails under expert guidance.

international.name: Healthy Drink
international.desc: Discover Bali's wellness traditions through naturally refreshing beverages.

gallery.body: Step behind the bar and discover the art of mixology through an immersive hands-on experience.

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.footnote: Prices are subject to an 11% government tax. USD figure is an estimated equivalent; you are billed in IDR.
